coverage: HSV saturation>0.05 AND value<0.98, on 256px patch; report only, never exclude
edge_rule: round(center-size/2); pad out-of-image with white; report in-image fraction; no spot deletion
selection: Mean within-section Spearman, then equal section average within patient, then equal validation-patient average; tie atol1e-12 selects larger alpha; all-NA picks largest and records reason
training: UNI2h only. StandardScaler fit train for validation; independent Ridge targets; selected alpha refit train+val. No PCA. Spot-weighted fits; patient-weighted validation.
undefined: Constant vectors or fewer than 3 finite spots => correlation NA; retain counts and reasons; no spot exclusions; metric finite pairs only for numerical failures explicitly counted
evaluation: Single locked-model prediction pass over all sections. Test and HER2ST Spearman evaluated once; train/val maps labeled fitted display, not held-out performance.
summary: Per-section Spearman, equal-section patient mean, cohort patient median; all patients and four programs, negatives and NA retained. No color baseline, residual sensitivity, reliability ceiling, paired comparison, significance test or wording threshold.

figures.map_color_limits: Observed and predicted panels each independently use within-section average-tie percentile ranks, 100*rank/n, with shared 0–100 colorbar. Absolute observed/predicted values stay unchanged in tables and arrays.

gallery.selection: Per-patient predicted extremes, round-robin across patients; take best remaining candidate score among patient fronts within each round. No observed-RNA selection. Stable ties by sample and spot_id.

eligibility.scope: Gallery selection only, after inference. Training, validation, held-out metrics and spatial maps use all spots. Never relax display eligibility to fill a gallery.

figures.colocalization: All six pairs. Within-section predicted average percentile rank per program; joint-high=min(rank_A,rank_B) mapped at measured spots. Predicted Spearman matrix per section. Cohort summaries only test/external, sections averaged within patient.
